name: PIK3CA in Breast Cancer
description: PIK3CA signaling and targeted therapy in breast cancer.
text: PIK3CA mutations are frequently observed in hormone receptor-positive breast cancer. PIK3CA activates the PI3K-AKT signaling pathway and promotes tumor cell growth. Alpelisib targets PI3K alpha and is used in PIK3CA-mutated breast cancer.
questions: What pathway is associated with PIK3CA?
